definition: feeling a need to eat food
description: A bearded man sits at a wooden dining table in front of a big white plate piled with creamy spaghetti. A brown dachshund is propped up behind him with its head peeping over his shoulder. Each time the man lifts a forkful of spaghetti, the dog stretches its neck around and grabs the strands from the fork before they reach his mouth, so the spaghetti hangs from the dog's jaws. The man pulls faces at the camera, wide-eyed and then laughing, while the dog keeps licking its lips and going back for more.

de.answer: Der hungrige Hund frisst seine Nudeln.
de.question: Was macht der Hund?

es.answer: El perro hambriento se está comiendo su pasta.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el perro?

fr.answer: Le chien affamé mange ses pâtes.
fr.question: Que fait le chien ?
